en.headline: Amber rainstorm warning issued as heavy rain hits New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the amber rainstorm signal on Tuesday morning, with waterlogged roads reported in Tai Po and Sha Tin.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 7.15am on Tuesday, stating that heavy rain exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour had fallen or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong and was likely to continue.

The Observatory warned that flooding may occur in some low-lying and poorly drained areas and that heavy rain could bring flash floods. Members of the public were advised to stay away from watercourses and to listen to radio or watch television for traffic updates and further announcements.
Drivers in the New Territories encountered waterlogged roads in Tai Po and Sha Tin on Tuesday morning, with reports of two minibuses becoming stalled. A Thunderstorm Warning was also in force.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 新界多處道路水浸
zh.dek: 天文台星期二早上發出黃色暴雨警告信號，大埔及沙田有道路水浸，兩輛小巴一度受阻。
body: 香港天文台星期二早上7時15分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示過去一小時香港廣泛地區已錄得或預計會錄得超過30毫米的雨量，並可能持續。
天文台提醒，部分低窪及排水系統欠佳的地區可能出現水浸，暴雨亦可引發山洪，市民應遠離河道，並留意電台或電視有關交通及進一步天氣消息。
新界大埔及沙田星期二早上有道路水浸，有報道指兩輛小巴一度受阻。當時雷暴警告亦同時生效。
